title: Bel Acueil le sergent d'Amours (Busnoys)
desc: Antoine Busnoys, Bel Acueil le sergent d'Amours. 3 voices (Discantus, Contra, Tenor), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Bus3009); encoded by Jesse Rodin. CC BY-NC 4.0. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
